prompt: Build a small e-commerce storefront called 'Cascade Shop'. Requirements: (1) A hardcoded catalog of at least 6 products, each with a name, a price, a one-line description, and an emoji as its image. (2) A catalog view: a responsive grid of product cards, each showing the emoji, name, price, and an 'Add to cart' button. (3) Clicking a product card opens a product detail view (large emoji, name, price, description, 'Add to cart', and a way back to the catalog). (4) A cart view: line items with name, unit price, a quantity stepper (+ / −), a 'Remove' button per line, and the order total. (5) A header with the shop name and a cart button showing a live item-count badge. (6) A 'Checkout' button in the cart that shows a form (name, email, address — all required with basic validation) and, on submit, a confirmation message that includes the order total. Use client-side state and view switching only (no router, no new dependencies), style with Tailwind, and keep `npm run build` passing.
